static_traits.name: 苏婷
static_traits.social_status: 有一位要好的朋友，但not yet与其讨论此恐惧；因害怕被评价而Reduced socializing与需盛装的工作活动参与。
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好；合作度高、态度积极；情绪上Significant anxiety与自我关注；倾向于跳到结论（读心术、预言not yet来）并negate正向反馈。

basic_info.main_problem: 我害怕因为偏爱穿黑色而被人嘲笑。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望通过咨询解决并克服这些负面想法，重新找回自信，not再过度担心他人看法。
growth_experiences: 几个月前在公司，一位同事对我全黑的穿着做了评论；自此开始害怕他人对我外表的看法，逐渐回避需要盛装的社交与工作活动。我认为这种恐惧源于社会关于穿黑色的规范与刻板印象；在穿黑色时尤为强烈，并伴随Anxiety与自我意识增强。

core_beliefs: I will be mocked or negatively evaluated by others for wearing black

special_situations.event: 在需要正式着装的工作或社交活动中
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我穿黑色出席，就会显得像参加葬礼或not合群，do not人会嘲笑我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids joining activities, or wears brighter clothes instead to fit in
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会笑我，觉得I am strange

special_situations.event: A few months ago, a colleague commented on my all-black outfit
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One negative comment shows that most people view my wearing black this way
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 从此提高警觉，外出前not断Anticipation负面评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 穿黑色会被认为在参加葬礼或not合时宜

special_situations.event: When I wear black to go out or think about going out wearing black
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I go out wearing black, I will surely encounter negative reactions from others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rehearses worst-case scenarios before going out and changes into colorful clothes to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today someone will definitely laugh at me because of my black clothes

special_situations.event: 有人对我的黑色穿搭给出正面评价
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对方称赞，那也只是出于礼貌，not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正向反馈，继续坚持对负面评价的Anticipation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是敷衍，内心还是在看not起我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望Freedom地表达自我（偏爱穿黑色）并被他人接纳、not被评判
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being ridiculed and rejected, losing social safety and career opportunities
defense_goal: By changing clothing and avoiding occasions, reduces the risk of negative evaluation by others and maintains a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: 易被评判、脆弱且not被接纳的自我
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/groups who love to criticize and may mock oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others point out the positive feedback of others on their attire, or ask about others' real views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes that others' praise is only out of politeness, while inside she is still belittling or mocking herself (transference: imposing the inner negative evaluation onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气Anxiety而笃定，use肯定句断言他人的负面意图（如“他们只是礼貌”）；对积极反馈予以解释性negate，避免讨论具体证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the cause of fear or needing to describe emotional experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses the abstract explanation of 'social norms and stereotypes' to replace directly feeling their own emotions and needs (transference: keeping distance from emotion)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explaining in objective, neutral terms, reducing emotional wording; steady and somewhat distant tone, emphasizing conceptual explanation rather than subjective feelings.

manifestations: Prefers wearing black but worries about violating social norms and others' expectations
Tries wearing brighter clothes to fit in, sacrificing self-expression
因害怕被评判而Reduced socializing互动、与朋友和同事保持距离
outcomes: Decreased drive与日常生活受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 频繁以“他们会笑我/看not起我”来归因他人动机
Presetting others' negative evaluations without evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned with clothing and external evaluation, restricting himself from attending activities

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将“社会对黑色的刻板印象”视为not可违背的规则
为迎合他人而改变穿着风格

exception_events.target_problem: 在穿黑色参加社交或工作场合时，来访者通常会预设他人负面评价并产生Anxiety，从而回避参与
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有几次在穿黑色的情况下，do not人对她的穿搭给予了称赞，与以往Anticipationnot同，并not yet出现嘲笑
exception_events.reason: 线索：由于当时他人直接表达正向反馈，实际互动提供了支持性证据，因此这次not yet出现负面反应

positive_force: Has a close friend she can confide in (potential social support)
Has received positive feedback about wearing black (realistic evidence)
Proactively seeking help and willing to try recording and re-evaluation (strong motivation to change)
negative_force: 过度跳到结论（读心术与预测not yet来）
将社会规范not yet经消化地Introjection，Repression自我表达

target_behavior.behavior: 回避需要盛装的社交与工作活动（伴随Significant anxiety与自我意识过强）
antecedent: 需要正式着装的活动邀请或安排
穿黑色外出或想到将穿黑色出门
回想同事曾对全黑穿搭的评论
target_behavior.core_reason: 基于一次他人评论与对社会刻板印象的关注而形成的跳到结论与预测not yet来的认知偏差，担心被嘲笑与负面评价
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与被评判的not适，维持短期安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、与朋友疏远、日常Increased anxiety与Decreased motivation
